title: Software Engineering Internship (C++ or Python) – Summer 2027
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking highly motivated full-time students to join our Software Engineering Summer Internship Program. HRT brings together the sharpest minds across quantitative disciplines—math, computer science, physics, engineering, and more— within our world-class computing environment to rapidly scale solutions to the toughest problems in tech and trading. Our software engineers create and maintain technology and infrastructure that is integral to the success of our trading. Ideal candidates are smart programmers who love to code, are eager to learn, and can thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.</p> <p><strong>What to Expect</strong></p> <ul> <li>A hands-on introduction to all technical facets of software engineering in the algorithmic trading industry</li> <li>Independent programming projects in Python, C, or C++, depending on the needs of the projectStructured and hands-on trainings, with quick transition into real projects within the first week</li> <li>Opportunities to learn all about HRT's research and trading infrastructure, even in areas you may not be working in directly</li> <li>Technical project work and mentorship, with the opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of global financial markets</li> <li>Plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow interns, participate in team events, and explore the unique culture, food, and experiences that make each HRT office location and cities special.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a full-time undergraduate student studying computer science or a related field</li> <li>Programming experience in Python, C or C++ is required</li> <li>A passion for technology and writing code that is elegant, readable, and efficient</li> <li>Exceptional problem solving skills</li> <li>Strong communication skills</li> <li>Knowledge of trading and/or financial markets is <strong>not required </strong>for this position</li> </ul> <p>We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, company-paid housing, meals, and other perks.</p> <p>New York: Weekly base salary of 5,800 USD<br>Singapore: Weekly base salary of 7,650 SGD<br>London: Weekly base salary of 4,350 GBP</p> <p><em><strong>We do not allow multiple applications. title: Software Engineer (C++ or Python) – 2027 Grads
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking talented Software Engineers to join our teams in New York, London, and Singapore. As a Software Engineer at HRT, the code you write is our business. Our software engineers create and maintain critical technology and infrastructure that is integral to the success of our trading. In this role, you will work closely with other engineers across the firm who design trading algorithms and monitor trading in an extremely fast-paced, real-time environment. Ideal candidates are smart programmers who love to code, enjoy being challenged, and can thrive in an open and collaborative environment.</p> <p><strong>Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>In your spare time you: code, tinker, read, explore, break things, and have an insatiable curiosity for all things computer-related — you'll find like-minded people here</li> <li>You are capable of working independently and as part of a team to analyze and fix problems quickly</li> <li>You can look at code, figure out how it works, and identify how to make it better</li> <li>You can describe software designs at a high level (the abstract interface), low level (step-by-step algorithm), and anywhere in between</li> <li>You enjoy working with people who push you to be better at what you do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a full-time undergraduate or master’s student studying computer science (or a related field) who is eligible for full-time roles in 2027</li> <li>Excellent design, debugging, and problem solving skills</li> <li>Working experience with C/C++ or Python is required, as are good CS fundamentals</li> <li>Knowledge of UNIX operating systems (we use Linux), system/processor performance, and network communication</li> <li>Interest in low-level architecture, logic design, and/or verification is a plus</li> </ul> <p>Base salary for US is $300,000. title: Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading
description:
<p>The Networks team designs, builds and maintains all the communications infrastructure that allows our high-capacity, low-latency trading and data research environments to run 24/7.  This network spans over 25 countries and 100 locations. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets. </p> <p>This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations. </p> <p>We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture.</p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related IT field</li> <li>5-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in low-latency and high-frequency trading environments.</li> <li>In depth understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols and best practices; working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP</li> <li>Experience managing Arista, Cisco, and other common networking devices on a day-to-day basis</li> <li>Familiarity with low-latency microwave networks and/or optical transmission systems, such as Adva, Ciena is desirable</li> <li>Experience in designing enterprise networks, capacity planning, and full lifecycle project management</li> <li>Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark</li> <li>Excellent oral and written communication skills: able to distill complicated issues into clear and concise terms and to create and maintain effective technical documentation</li> <li>Experience with Unix/Linux command line utilities and networking stack</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting skills on a wide range of networking issues, including common ethernet LAN problems, multicast market data distribution, and global WAN</li> <li>Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a datacenter environment</li> <li>Knowledge of fiber optics technology and cabling standards. Ability to sort through specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases</li> <li>Willingness and ability to solve small technical problems in the field yourself.</li> <li>You have excellent collaboration skills and a willingness to admit mistakes.</li> <li>Familiarity with firewalls (including Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet), VPNs and NAT</li> <li>Familiarity with configuration management tools, such as Ansible or Salt is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with Python, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, GitHub is desirable</li> <li>Familiarity with public cloud networks, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, is desirable</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. title: Research Data Expert
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking aResearch Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.</p> <p>In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.</p> <p>HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Responsibilities</span></h2> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research</li> <li>Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain</li> <li>Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets</li> <li>Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation</li> <li>Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities.Analyze data to identify and improve alpha</li> <li>Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets</li> <li>Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours</li> <li>Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Qualifications</span></h2> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies</li> <li>5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)</li> <li>Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysisExceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a STEM field</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). title: Senior Enterprise Risk Manager (Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Pantheon has been at the forefront of private markets investing for more than 40 years, earning a reputation for an innovative approach to investing in secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund investments, as well as capital formation across commingled funds, evergreen vehicles and customized solutions. Through our collaborative and committed culture, we find new ways to solve complex problems together and deliver innovative investment opportunities across private markets. Pantheon currently manages approximately $82.3 billion in AUM across all its strategies, serving more than 750 institutional and 638 private wealth clients worldwide</span></p> <p>For further details please visit <a href="http://www.pantheon.com">www.pantheon.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>The Senior Enterprise Risk Manager will support the Enterprise Risk function on a fixed-term basis to support the delivery of key regulatory and risk management initiatives. operational risk management capabilities across the business.<br>The position will report directly to the Head of Enterprise Risk and will work closely with senior stakeholders across all business functions to strengthen risk governance, controls documentation, and regulatory readiness.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Internal Controls System (ICS) Framework</p> <ul> <li>Support the enhancement, and implementation of the firm's Internal Controls System (ICS) framework.</li> <li>Partner with business owners to identify, document, and assess key processes, risks, and controls.</li> <li>Drive the centralisation of risk and control documentation to meet evolving regulatory expectations.</li> <li>Ensure risk and control inventories are complete, accurate, and maintained within the firm's designated governance platform.</li> <li>Challenge and validate control design and effectiveness to support a robust control environment.</li> </ul> <p>Regulatory Programme Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Support the delivery of regulatory commitments relating to PIN and PINT, including requirements under Provision 34.</li> <li>Coordinate with first and second line stakeholders to gather, review, and evidence regulatory deliverables.</li> <li>Assist in preparing materials, documentation, and management reporting for regulatory reviews and internal governance forums.</li> <li>Track progress against regulatory milestones and identify risks, issues, and dependencies impacting delivery.</li> </ul> <p>Enterprise and Operational Risk Management</p> <ul> <li>Support the continued enhancement of the enterprise and operational risk management frameworks (such as Fraud and Operational Resilience frameworks).</li> <li>Identify control gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities for framework improvement.</li> <li>Support incident, issue, and remediation management activities where required.</li> <li>Support and management of data privacy related framework enhancements </li> </ul> <p>Stakeholder Engagement</p> <ul> <li>Build strong working relationships with business leaders and risk owners across the organisation.</li> <li>Provide guidance and challenge on risk and controls best practice.</li> <li>Facilitate workshops and working sessions to support process mapping, risk assessment, and controls documentation activities.</li> <li>Deliver clear and concise reporting to senior management and governance committees.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Knowledge and Experience Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience within Enterprise Risk, Operational Risk, Internal Controls, or Risk Transformation within financial services (incl. operational resilience, outsourcing, or third-party risk frameworks).</li> <li>Experience supporting risk framework enhancement, or governance programmes.</li> <li>Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), process mapping, and controls documentation.</li> <li>Experience implementing or enhancing Internal Controls System (ICS) frameworks.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial services regulatory expectations and governance requirements.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience partnering with senior business stakeholders and control owners.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently, manage multiple workstreams, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience within asset management, private markets, banking, or investment management environments would be advantageous.</li> <li>Experience supporting regulatory engagements or remediation programmes.</li> <li>Knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) systems.</li> <li>Experience developing centralised risk and controls libraries.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>This job description is not title: Account Executive with German
description: <h1><strong>About the Team</strong></h1> <p>The Sales team at SevenRooms is on a mission to reshape the hospitality industry by empowering operators to take control of their guest relationships. We’re a passionate, high-performing group of go-getters who act as trusted advisors to restaurants and hospitality groups around the world. We take a consultative approach to sales—identifying business gaps, crafting thoughtful solutions, and helping operators reduce reliance on third-party networks. We believe in the power of hospitality, and we’re proud to partner with businesses to streamline operations and deliver magical guest experiences every day.</p> <h1><strong>About the Role</strong></h1> <p>As an Account Executive, you’ll work directly with restaurants and hospitality groups to understand their business needs and recommend the best-fit SevenRooms solutions—from reservations and table management to online ordering and marketing automation. You’ll drive new business by adding operators to the platform and working closely with our onboarding and account teams to ensure a smooth and enthusiastic transition. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.</p> <h1><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline</strong>. Identify and engage prospective restaurants and hospitality groups to grow your book of business.</li> <li><strong>Showcase the Platform.</strong> Present the value of SevenRooms through compelling demos and conversations that help operators understand how we can support their success.</li> <li><strong>Lead Sales from Start to Finish.</strong> Own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and pitching to negotiation, contracting, and go-live support.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Live Product Demos.</strong> Conduct live, engaging product walkthroughs both virtually and in person when needed.</li> <li><strong>Be a Trusted Partner.</strong> Build strong relationships with prospects and clients, always advocating for their success and acting as a true advisor throughout the process.</li> </ul> <h1><strong>We’re excited about you because…</strong></h1> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of experience in hospitality technology sales</li> <li>You’re confident presenting to clients both in person and virtually</li> <li>You’re self-driven and comfortable working independently, whether in the office or remotely</li> <li>You’re tech-savvy and quick to pick up new tools and platforms</li> <li>You’re results-oriented and bring energy and focus to your daily work</li> <li>You’ve worked with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or similar systems</li> <li>You have a background in hospitality or restaurants (a big plus!)</li> <li>You’re open to occasional travel into key markets to connect with clients face-to-face</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>You speak fluent German and English</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="font-weight: 500;">Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only</p> <p>We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. Results of the audit may be viewed here: <a style="text-decoration: underline;" href="https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144">Covey</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Shape the test strategy that proves Graphcore firmware is ready for production hardware.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will lead firmware QA across Graphcore’s next-generation hardware platforms. You will verify the low level software behind boot, configuration and monitoring.</p> <p>Your tests will protect production firmware quality, from power sequencing to hardware interfaces and telemetry. You will create reliable gates for firmware used across teams and systems.</p> <p>You will design test infrastructure, build high coverage tests and debug issues with hardware and analysers. You will also guide best practice while staying close to the code.</p> <p>This role needs technical breadth, embedded systems depth and calm ownership of difficult problems. You will shape how firmware quality scales at Graphcore.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join the Firmware QA team within System Software QA. The team validates low level software for complete boot, configuration and monitoring of Graphcore silicon and hardware platforms.</p> <p>Work happens close to hardware, across firmware, software and platform teams. You will turn requirements and use cases into acceptance tests that protect production quality.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, technical discussion and clear ownership. You will speak up, set standards and mentor engineers through practical, hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Significant experience in firmware qualification across complex embedded systems.<br>· Deep understanding of real time embedded systems and complex boot logic.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers and analysers.<br>· Strong understanding of silicon and hardware interfaces, including I2C, I3C, SMBus, SPI, PCIe, DDR and power management.<br>· Experience with CI/CD, build tools and modern testing practices.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues, drive root-cause investigations and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to shape firmware quality for Graphcore’s next-generation hardware platforms? Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.</p> <h4><strong>Role Overview</strong></h4> <p>As a <strong>Staff Platform Engineer,</strong> you operate with broad organizational impact. underline;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Define and document enterprise-wide standards for AI integration, establishing prompt engineering patterns and validation frameworks that scale development velocity without compromising architectural integrity.</li> <li>Orchestrate the identification of AI-generated code pitfalls—such as security vulnerabilities and over-abstraction—while quantifying the business impact through PR velocity and quality metrics.</li> <li>Lead the design and evolution of highly available, scalable infrastructure, ensuring the platform remains resilient under the demands of multi-disciplinary engineering teams.</li> <li>Architect robust CI/CD ecosystems and developer tooling, focusing on eliminating friction in the software delivery lifecycle and driving organization-wide productivity.</li> <li>Serve as a subject matter expert for platform security, implementing sophisticated safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.</li> <li>Drive the strategic roadmap for system observability, implementing advanced monitoring, tracing, and alerting architectures to ensure peak operational reliability.</li> <li>Act as a primary technical liaison between engineering, product, and quantitative teams to translate complex requirements into scalable, innovative platform solutions.</li> <li>Foster a culture of high performance and continuous learning, mentoring engineers on best practices, managing incident response strategies, and advocating for the adoption of transformative technologies</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>8 plus years of experience in platform engineering or DevOps, with a proven track record of architecting scalable, high-availability cloud-native environments (AWS/Kubernetes).</li> <li>Expert proficiency in using AI collaborators (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to ship production code, with a documented ability to optimize personal and team development workflows.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability to articulate the pros/cons of various AI tools and implement rigorous validation strategies to identify pitfalls like over-abstraction or security gaps.</li> <li>Deep technical mastery of IaC frameworks such as Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation to automate complex infrastructure lifecycles.</li> <li>Strong programming proficiency in Java and Python (Golang preferred) with a full-stack background to bridge the gap between infrastructure and application logic.</li> <li>Extensive experience building mature CI/CD pipelines and implementing advanced observability, chaos testing, and incident management frameworks.</li> <li>Self-directed leader who thrives in ambiguous environments, balancing high-quality architectural standards with data-driven productivity metrics.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and partnership skills, with a proven ability to influence engineering, product, and quant teams across international borders.</li> <li>Team-first mentality focused on driving operational excellence, mentoring others, and proactively adopting emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><em><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></em></span></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience in high-growth startup environments</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects or technical community</li> <li>Experience with real-money transaction systems and regulatory compliance</li> <li>Background in building developer tools or improving engineering productivity</li> <li>Experience leading without authority and influencing technical direction across teams</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!<em> </em>Please note that <strong>visa sponsorship is not available</strong> for this position. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.</p> <h4><strong>Role Overview</strong></h4> <p>As a <strong>Senior Platform Engineer, </strong>you will be a key driver of our core infrastructure and developer experience. You will design and implement durable platform abstractions and partner with engineering leads to ensure our systems enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.</p> <p>This role requires a balance of deep hands-on engineering and systems thinking. You will own complex features from ideation to production, championing best-in-class platform standards and mentoring mid-level engineers while remaining deeply embedded in the codebase.</p> <p>On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Implement team-level standards for AI-augmented development, utilizing prompt engineering and validation frameworks to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and assist in tracking team productivity metrics.</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain highly available cloud-native infrastructure, ensuring the platform scales reliably with our growing user base.</li> <li>Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling to eliminate friction in the software delivery lifecycle.</li> <li>Implement and maintain platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.</li> <li>Contribute to the system observability roadmap by implementing monitoring, tracing, and alerting to ensure high operational reliability.</li> <li>Partner with product and engineering teams to translate technical requirements into scalable platform solutions.</li> <li>Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, lead incident response for team-owned services, and advocate for modern engineering best practices.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience and Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li>5 plus years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or backend engineering, with a track record of building scalable, cloud-native environments (AWS/Kubernetes).</li> <li>Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to ship production code and an ability to optimize personal development workflows.</li> <li>Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural "hallucinations" and implement rigorous testing strategies.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience with IaC frameworks such as <strong>Terraform</strong>, Pulumi, or CloudFormation.</li> <li>High proficiency in Java and Python (Golang is a plus). You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.</li> <li>Experience building mature CI/CD pipelines and working with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog).</li> <li>Proven ability to take ownership of complex projects in a fast-paced environment, balancing speed with architectural health.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.</li> </ul> <p><em>Preferred Qualifications</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience in high-growth startup environments.</li> <li>Experience with financial systems, real-money transactions, or regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Background in building internal developer tools or CLI applications.</li> <li>Experience leading small project groups or "squads" within a larger team.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!<em> </em>Please note that <strong>visa sponsorship is not available</strong> for this position. We are open to <strong>fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. </strong>Remote employee may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p>#LI-AL1 </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director Vertical Marketing - Energy & Defence
description: Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. Our ambition is to become the operating layer for entire industries. We’re looking for a Director Vertical Marketing - Energy & Defence to build our position in these markets as part of a world-class vertical marketing team. You’ll combine deep customer understanding, a clear industry point of view and commercial judgement to turn an opportunity into a repeatable way to win. You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Energy and Defence, partnering closely with the relevant Sales Managers and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams. What you’ll do Understand the market and choose where to focus. Interview customers, prospects and specialist partners to uncover buying triggers, workflows and unmet needs. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities across energy developers, operators, services and technology businesses, and defence technology and service suppliers with project or contract complexity. Define the proposition. Turn customer insight into clear positioning, competitive arguments and a credible industry point of view. Work with Product Marketing to create customer stories, demonstrations and sales kits that show why Light matters to each segment. Own the marketing pipeline. Build the model, set campaign priorities and lead execution with Demand Generation and Field Marketing. Own weekly reporting on qualified opportunities, conversion and progress against pipeline targets, with clear actions when performance falls short. Make AI part of the operating rhythm. Use AI for research, campaign execution and reporting that gets to the why behind the numbers. Investigate what drives conversion and where deals stall, validate the findings with customer and Sales evidence, and turn them into decisions. Be a true partner to Sales. Train direct sales reps and SDRs on the nuances of Energy and Defence: their buyers, language, workflows, procurement cycles, contract structures, regulatory context and objections. Join important customer conversations and equip the team with the insight and proof needed to move deals forward. Build credibility in the sectors. Speak at relevant conferences, roundtables, webinars and industry discussions. Develop relationships with industry associations, analysts, specialist advisors, ecosystem partners and credible sector voices who shape how buyers think. Build trust in environments where domain expertise, procurement complexity and security or regulatory considerations matter. Bring the customer voice into the product. Partner with Product Marketing to define the workflows, integrations and product requirements critical to these sectors. This includes needs around project and contract economics, multi-entity reporting, cash visibility, auditability, approvals, evidence trails and integrations with operational or project systems. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver. Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies where appropriate. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message, partner strategy, events and campaigns. What you’ll bring Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results. Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change. An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with analysts, partners and industry media. Experience building trusted relationships in anadjacent complex B2B sector where domain credibility, long buying cycles and multiple stakeholders matter. A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility. Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request. Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations. Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, map the market, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results. You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both. What success looks like Clear priorities for Energy and Defence, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next. Sales reps and SDRs understand the commercial, procurement and operating nuances of each segment and have the training, content, customer proof and partner routes to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most. You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value. How we work Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort. This is an opportunity to shape priority markets from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering. The good stuff 🏢 In-office culture, high talent density. 💸 Competitive salary. 🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. 🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal. 🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Energy & Defence customers, partners and industry events take us. 🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy. How to apply Tell us about a specialist market you helped grow: how you built the pipeline, earned credibility with customers and partners, and equipped Sales to win. Share a time your analysis changed the plan, and how customer insight shaped a product requirement. Light is an equal opportunity employer. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI & Revenue Operations Lead
description: Light brings together the ledger, apps tailored to individual businesses and AI agents that carry out finance workflows. We are building the financial foundation for companies operating across entities, currencies and industries. We are looking for an ambitious leader with practical AI expertise, sharp commercial judgement and the ability to turn strategy into execution. Working directly with the VP Sales, you will help shape where we invest, identify what holds us back and build the systems that move us forward. You will be a close strategic and execution partner: prepared, proactive and comfortable challenging constructively. Bring a clear point of view, turn decisions into owners and deadlines, and drive work across teams through to adoption. What you’ll own AI and automation. Build reliable AI agents and connected workflows for account research, meeting intelligence, opportunity inspection, follow-ups, forecasting and reporting. Connect models to business data and systems, evaluate accuracy and measure the time saved and commercial impact. Growth planning and market intelligence. Partner with GTM and Finance on territories, capacity, hiring, quotas and investment. Identify patterns in the customers we win and the problems they buy us to solve. Turn regional, industry and partner opportunities into credible operating plans. Revenue performance and board reporting. Own a trusted view of pipeline, conversion, win rates, sales cycles, productivity, retention and expansion. Help the VP Sales and Finance prepare the commercial board pack, translating performance and forecasts into a clear narrative and recommendations. Participate in relevant board discussions as required. Sales execution and systems. Improve HubSpot, lead routing, attribution, data quality and handoffs across Lead → Close → Renew → Expand. Embed MEDDIC, stage gates, economic buyer engagement, pricing approvals and forecast discipline. Make direct and partner performance visible. Leadership and scale. Drive weekly reviews and quarterly execution plans with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, Implementation and Finance. Give managers actionable insight into pipeline, coaching and capacity. Strengthen onboarding, the sales playbook and prospect-specific demo workflows. What you bring Practical AI expertise. You have built and deployed working AI workflows, connected tools and data through APIs or automation, and managed accuracy and reliability. You can show what you built, who uses it and what improved. Commercial and analytical strength. You understand recurring revenue and pipeline economics. You can build planning models independently, interrogate assumptions and turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are expected; SQL, BI and scripting are valuable. Hands-on delivery. You are comfortable improving CRM systems, ideally HubSpot, and connecting the GTM stack. You have owned a meaningful initiative from diagnosis to implementation, adoption and measurable results. Leadership and judgement. You earn trust, influence across functions and challenge senior colleagues with evidence. You set priorities, bring people with you and know when to act or escalate. Ambition and discipline . You learn quickly, seek responsibility and maintain high standards at pace. Your background may be in RevOps, GTM engineering, AI, strategy or consulting. Evidence of impact matters more than a fixed number of years or a particular degree. Your first 90 days 30 days: understand the revenue engine, establish performance and workload baselines, and agree the highest value priorities with the VP Sales. 60 days: deliver a trusted performance view, strengthen the forecast cadence and put the first priority AI workflows into use. 90 days: demonstrate adoption and measurable improvement; deliver a quarterly operating plan and a prioritised automation roadmap with clear owners. What success looks like Leadership makes better decisions with trusted data. Forecasts become more reliable, opportunities move with stronger evidence and managers know where to focus. AI reduces manual work and improves execution. Teams work from consistent definitions, and the VP Sales has a partner who anticipates issues and drives delivery. Why Light We offer direct access to commercial leadership, exposure to board preparation, opportunities to present your analysis and recommendations, and meaningful ownership in an ambitious AI finance business, with responsibility that grows with your impact. In addition, we offer the following: 🏢 In-office culture, high talent density. 💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options 🏝 25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based 🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites 🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product Show us what you have built Bring an example of a system, automation or commercial initiative you owned: the problem, what you built, how you brought people with you and what changed. title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
description: Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx. I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies. Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work. We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business. Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure. You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room.. What you'll be doing Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort. Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person. Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project. Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you. Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for. Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend. Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role. Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information. Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues. You're unlikely to thrive here if You struggle to adapt to change or ambiguity, or find it difficult to collaborate across diverse teams. You're not energised by a culture that values ownership, feedback, and continuous learning. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off and learn more about your background. Manager interview with our People Lead to explore your experience in more depth. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team. Values interview to get to know how you work and how that aligns with hx's culture with our VP of People and Senior Director of Finance and Operations. Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page. Check out our blog at Insights & Blog - hyperexponential Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Core Markets - Integrated Marketing
description: We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, and individuals with disabilities to apply. Bumble is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). Bumble is looking for a Director, International Core Markets, Integrated Marketing to lead the strategy and performance of our portfolio of established international markets. Reporting to the VP of International Markets, you will be responsible for defining what it takes for Bumble to win across our Core Markets, protecting and strengthening our market position while identifying the next opportunities for sustainable growth, cultural relevance, and brand leadership.This is a senior leadership and people management role. You will lead and develop a team of market leaders, setting clear strategic direction while empowering them to translate Bumble's global strategy into locally relevant, insight-led market plans. You are a strategic and empathetic leader who sets a high bar for both thinking and execution. You know how to coach teams, navigate complexity, challenge established approaches, make difficult prioritization decisions, and create an environment where people have the clarity, autonomy, and support to do their best work. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own the strategy and performance of Bumble's International Core Markets portfolio, establishing a clear long term vision, drives sustainable growth, and remains culturally relevant in each market. Lead and develop a high-performing team of market leaders, setting clear direction and empowering them to own outcomes. Drive alignment across the portfolio, ensuring teams stay focused on priorities, share learnings, and adapt quickly as business needs evolve. Regularly assess performance across the portfolio and make deliberate choices about where to prioritize, where to invest, where to optimize. Establish clear success measures across the portfolio and champion a strong culture of measurement and learning. Use performance and consumer insights to continuously challenge assumptions and evolve market strategies. Build strong partnerships with Global Marketing, Creative, Media, Product Marketing, Growth, Communications, Partnerships, Research & Insights and other cross-functional teams, ensuring Core Market priorities are clearly represented and incorporated into broader company plans. Communicate portfolio performance, priorities, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership, translating complexity into clear recommendations and decisions. Build a high performing and inclusive team culture grounded in trust, accountability, openness, and mutual respect. Act as a senior leader within the broader International organization, contributing beyond the Core Markets portfolio by sharing frameworks, market learnings, leadership practices, and strategic perspectives that raise the effectiveness of the wider team. KEY SKILLS Bachelor's degree; MBA or Master's is a plus +12 years of experience in brand, integrated, or strategic marketing, ideally in consumer tech, lifestyle, or culturally-driven brands. Significant experience in senior brand, integrated, strategic, or market marketing leadership roles, ideally within consumer technology, lifestyle, entertainment, or other culturally driven brands. Proven experience leading multiple markets, business units, or a complex portfolio, with accountability for setting strategy, determining priorities, and driving measurable business and brand outcomes. Strong people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to coach and develop high performing teams and managers. Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move between the portfolio level view and individual market dynamics and determine what matters most. Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex market challenges by synthesizing information and translating those insights into clear strategic choices. Strong commercial and analytical judgment, with experience using data, measurement, and ROI frameworks to inform prioritization, investment decisions, and changes in strategy. Deep understanding of integrated marketing and the role of brand, media, creators, partnerships, communications, experiential, product marketing, and growth in driving both brand and business outcomes. Understanding of international marketing and the balance between global consistency and meaningful local relevance. Proven ability to influence and align senior cross functional stakeholders. Excellent executive communication skills. Ability to operate effectively in a fast moving environment. Excellent relationship building, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. ABOUT YOU You are a portfolio strategist. You can look across multiple markets, identify the few challenges and opportunities that matter most, and translate them into a clear direction for the organization. You are a leader of leaders. You create clarity and set a high bar. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and dive in when necessary.. You are deeply consumer and culture focused but equally comfortable with business performance and data. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and can create structure and direction without waiting for every answer to be available. You are an exceptional collaborator who builds trust across functions. You are energized by change and know how to lead others through it with clarity, transparency, resilience, and optimism. You think beyond established playbooks. You are willing to test new approaches and encourage your teams to do the same when existing solutions are no longer sufficient. You are an excellent communicator who can turn complexity into a clear story. About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Inclusion at Bumble Inc. Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc). AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly. Fraudulent Candidate Detection Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy . title: Menswear Product Manager-Manchester Shambles
description: Job Title PRODUCT MANAGER Full time position Reporting to SD / GENERAL Manager Purpose Key Responsibilities Is responsible for the commercial identity of the store. Analysis the performance of the store/department (Clothes, Tempe and Perfumes) in order to ensure the achievement of sales targets, using the appropriate analysis tools and planning the correct strategy COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE AND ANALYSIS: · Analyse sales data for the Store and adjust strategies as necessary to maximise sales · To plan the strategy for the store with the Store Director/General Manager on a weekly basis. · Oversee the store plan and layouts to enhance commercial strategy and optimise the customer shopping experience · To work alongside the Regional and National Team ensuring that all Country strategies are implemented according to your customer profile by planning and organising workshops in store. · In depth knowledge of all commercial applications: Retail app, Merchan app, Alert exposition, Itx stock, Deliveries app, Money mapping … · To prepare and lead official in store visits evaluating sales potential, and providing strategy feedback and product needs. · Work closely with OPS Managers to synchronise visual strategies with promotional activities, product launches. · Follow up on stock management by revising and lead the proposals for backstocks in line with the weekly strategy. · Control product levels in the store and communicate with Senior Management and Spain PM if any products are needed. · Ensure scheduling is done for the Commercial Team in Orquest in line with company guidelines. VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY: · Develop and execute the visual merchandising strategy to align with brands identity, market trends and business goals · Ensure seasonal planning is reflected on the shop floor according to the commercial calendar and Company strategies following season trends and market needs. · To identify and implement creative and visual ideas for the store, manage in store furniture, lighting and internal mannequins in order to maintain high standards of image. · Ensure windows are up to standards and propose changes when necessary. · Keep up to date with the latest fashion trends and participates in Fashionista projects. TEAM LEADERSHIP & DEVELOPMENT: · To be responsible for the training and development of the Commercial team by ensuring that regular feedback, reviews and adequate training is given. · Identify and develop potentials within the store and manger succession plans with the relevant follow up on LEAP. · To lead and keep a high level of motivation within the team · Daily commercial updates with the team to ensure they are informed, engaged and equipped to drive sales and deliver exceptional customer service. · To be responsible for all payroll processes and comply with deadlines · To ensure that all ER processes are followed according to the company policy in managing formal and informal meetings, sickness and absence. · To be an ambassador in the company’s sustainability project and ensures that the store upholds and works towards finding new, innovative and economically reductive ways to be sustainable. Ensure that all company related initiative are fulfilled. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE: · Lead by example and contribute to the highest standards of customer service across the store. · Deep understanding of customer behaviour and profile, and takes actions to improve the product knowledge of the team to increase sales and achieve commercial goals. · Be able to solve and manage customer issues and escalate to the customer service team if necessary. · Actively participates in all the actions to improve Customer Experience SECURITY PROCEDURES: · Support to ensure security and funds management procedures are followed rigorously by all employees in the store and all relevant documentation has been signed. · Support with the organisation of the security team and all procedures related. · Open and close cash desk and gives support to cash desk team · Monitor cash discrepancies level and report to line management. · Oversees the banking procedures and follow up any incident reported by L&P Department. · Support with the request of change and follows up accordingly. · To support with all store security procedures to minimise stock loss and supports action plans accordingly. · Support to ensure security and funds management procedures are followed rigorously by all employees in the store and all relevant documentation has been signed. H & S: · To be aware of the risks of employees and customers are exposed to and to be aware of safe work practices and company procedures to overcome them · To ensure good housekeeping is maintained throughout all areas in the store and to be able to use the HS Net app to report accidents Experience and qualifications · Previous fashion retail experience essential · Experience in Merchandising, preferably in a similar environment. · A fashion/textile design qualification is desirable but not essential. · Proven record of creating and implementing successful commercial actions. Skills and Attitudes · Passionate about fashion. · Ability to lead by example, motivate and develop the team. · Ability to demonstrate commerciality involving current trends and forecasting future trends. · Strong time management and organisational skills. · Strong interpersonal skills with an emphasis on building partnerships, managing conflict and influencing others. · High level of numeracy, written and verbal communication skills are essential. · Strong knowledge of Keynote, with the ability to design and deliver visually compelling presentations. · Ability to drive change: open minded, flexible, adaptable, oriented to results, embraces technology and innovation. · Resilient and able to handle pressure and react quickly to situations, making timely decisions in challenging conditions / circumstances. This job description is designed to help you understand your role better and to improve the effectiveness of our recruitment process. It is not an exhaustive list of all the things that you may be required to do and maybe required to take on additional tasks. Inditex is an equal opportunities employer. Our teams include people from a wide range of cultures, backgrounds, and experiences, including a mix of race, Gender, gender identity and expression, ethnicity, age, education, socioeconomic groups, disabilities, Religious beliefs, sexual orientation etc. Inditex champions a culture inclusion and acceptance.
