title: Senior UI Designer
description: Your mission Native designs products that get made. Since 1997 we've worked across the US, Europe and Asia for the companies that take the object seriously: Bowers & Wilkins, Bang & Olufsen, Audi, Coloplast, Baxter, Bentley, HP and others we can't name yet. Along the way we've collected more international design awards than any independent studio in Europe. We've turned down every offer to be acquired because independence is what lets us tell a client the truth. We're looking for a passionate, collaborative and creative Senior UI Designer with an impeccable eye for beauty, a head full of ideas and a strong sense of creative direction to join our studio in Shoreditch. We're hired to create wholly new products and experiences, so we're as much inventors as designers. As a Senior UI Designer, you'll help define the future of our digital output, shaping remarkable experiences across tech, healthcare, wellness and automotive. You'll set visual design direction and deliver excellence across many platforms - from multi-modal AI experiences, beautiful UI, emotionally engaging motion design and 3D prototypes. You'll take ownership of creative output, grow into a mentorship role, and have a genuine influence on how the studio evolves. You'll work with some of the world's best designers, developers, anthropologists, strategists, and engineers to make work that pushes boundaries, challenges perceptions, and - occasionally - changes the world. Your profile You Here’s an idea of the sort of Senior UI Designer we hope is reading this: Experienced & Agency-Tested: You’ve honed your skills in a fast-paced, creative, (product, advertising, marketing or branding) agency environment, where you’ve delivered high-impact work across a range of industries. Storyteller : You don’t just design, you shape narratives. You can articulate the thinking behind your work in a way that resonates with clients, teams, and users alike. AI proficient : You actively explore new AI tools and thoughtfully integrate them into your workflow - not for novelty, but to elevate speed, craft, and thinking. Cross-Disciplinary Fluent: You understand 3D and motion – bridging the gap between tactile and digital. Visionary Thinker: You are full of ideas and bring creative thinking and technological curiosity to every challenge. You push what’s possible and influence others to do the same. Leadership Minded: You're ready to step into a bigger role. You naturally guide more junior designers, earn trust across disciplines, and think about the craft at a studio level not just project level. Craft-Led: You're obsessive about typography, hierarchy, layout, and interaction, with an eye for flawless visual execution. Adaptable: We're not afraid to scrap an idea. Sometimes, we build it, test it, and start again. If this doesn't fill you with dread, and you're excited by the idea of being the person who helps shape what comes next, you'll make the work of your life at Native Passionate: A passion for what you do is essential. We believe the best creatives genuinely enjoy their work. Why us? Us Here's what you can expect from us: Annual Leave 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays. We actively encourage you to take your leave. Enhanced Parental Leave Enhanced maternity and paternity pay. Private Healthcare Bupa private medical insurance, including 24/7 GP access, mental health support, and specialist care. A health and wellness cashback plan. Wellbeing & Fitness 40% discount across the Hussle Gym network. Access to YuLife wellbeing and fitness benefits, including mindfulness resources, company-wide challenges and cash rewards. Professional Development Opportunities for learning and development, access to industry talks, exhibitions, and visiting speakers. Studio Culture Regular company events and studio activities throughout the year. Location Our Shoreditch studio is well connected and surrounded by a vibrant design and technology community. Independent Studio Native has operated independently in East London for almost 30 years. We are committed to long-term thinking, craft, and delivering thoughtful innovation without compromise. title: Product Manager

Applications with solely web, digital marketing or CRM experience will not be considered. Your profile Responsibilities Product Strategy & Delivery Deliver the mobile product strategy, as defined by the Senior Product Manager. Manage the app through all stages of the lifecycle: discovery through to optimisation and iteration. Own the continuous improvement of the app, including accessibility, onboarding and bootflow. Manage the app’s technical health and stability across a range of devices. Create, maintain, and prioritise product backlogs, ensuring alignment with organisation goals and user needs. Define user stories with acceptance criteria and guide development teams through delivery. Continuous Improvement Monitor and analyse app performance using data, analytics, and feedback loops. Drive a culture of continuous optimisation and regular update cadence. Keep up-to-date with product management best practices, trends, OS and app store trends, bringing innovations into the CALMzone app. Your profile Competencies Mobile app lifecycle management Product strategy Agile execution and delivery Data-driven decision making Stakeholder management Cross-functional collaboration - working with both technical and non-technical teams Experience Hands-on Mobile app experience: 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager launching and/or running a mobile app. Junior or associate Product Managers will be considered. Experience managing an app through the full product lifecycle, including familiarity with App Store and Google Play releases processes. Strong UX background with experience leading user journey mapping, defining user stories, and ensuring inclusive, accessible design. Excellent ability to work across teams and with external partners (designers, developers, agencies). Strong analytical skills, using data and research to inform decisions. Confident communicator and stakeholder manager, able to champion product thinking across CALM. Desirable Skills & Experience Experience managing web platforms, CMS development, or digital products alongside mobile apps. Experience with livechat products such as WhatsApp, or AWS webchat. Familiarity with CRM systems (especially Salesforce) and integration with mobile app data. Experience working in an environment where time-management, prioritisation and adaptability are key. Awareness of the not-for-profit or charity sector, or experience working with diverse user groups. Why us? title: Senior Copywriter
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p> <p>For more information, please visit <a href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="d4b7d1c3-8ad6-4b6d-ab45-d3cb5a3aebe1">www.vml.com </a>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&e=" data-outlook-id="a3ef68bf-16fb-4ebc-9ca9-406007d6cefc">LinkedIn</a> #WeAreVML.</p></div><p><strong>Company: </strong><strong>VML</strong></p> <p><strong>Working Model: </strong><strong>Hybrid working</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><strong>Sea Containers office, London, SE1</strong></p> <p>At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.</p> <p>Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our 3 core practices; Brand experience, Customer experience and Commerce. Within these practices we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.</p> <p><strong>The Role: Senior Copywriter</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a senior writer, to work on one of the world’s leading car groups – covering a range of brands on their roster.</p> <p>The ideal candidate needs to be a conceptually sound creative with a history of big ideas. title: People Performance Manager
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Performance Manager to join our Performance Service. tem is growing fast. Our goal is to get better as we get bigger - revenue growing faster than headcount. In practice that means keeping our strongest people engaged and performing, getting new joiners productive quickly, and enabling our leaders to multiply their impact over time. Most companies solve that with layers of management. We don't. Our leaders (Player-Coaches) coach their teams while staying hands-on with the work, which means the systems around them have to do more of the lifting. That's where the Performance Service comes in. We're a team of four, and we own how tem runs as an organisation: the operating rhythm (how work gets planned, tracked, escalated and reported), the onboarding and development that build capability, the frameworks that define what good performance looks like and how people progress and get paid, and the operational backbone of contracts, benefits and payroll. We don't own recruitment. We're adding a second Performance Partner because we need more hands on deck - both partnering with our leaders day to day, and building the frameworks that support them. Your patch is sustained performance - the part that runs continuously once someone is through the door. You'll carry a portfolio of leaders across our Engines and Services that you're accountable for, and you'll co-own the frameworks that sit underneath them alongside the rest of the team. You will not be handed a finished playbook to administer. You'll report into the Performance Service Manager. HR experience is welcome but not required - we're open to operators, people who've led teams, and the sort of person who ends up owning whatever the company needs next. In your first 12 months, you might: Become the first call for a portfolio of leaders on anything to do with their people - performance calls, team decisions and hard conversations. Co-design how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. Handle live cases end to end - performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures. Use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process. Turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, and measure whether they work. 🛠️ Responsibilities Coach and challenge: be a leader's first call on anything to do with their people - a decision they want a second view on, coaching on how to handle a situation, or a read on employment law - and hold a position when you disagree with them. Raise the bar: hold leaders to a high standard on performance, potential, pay and progression - help them make sharper calls, and hold consistency across your patch. Handle live cases end to end: performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures. Build to delight: shape how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. We treat our people like top athletes, and our aim is to delight them at every step of their employee experience - the systems around them have to express that at every contact point. Design for our shape, not the textbook: we index on outcomes and impact in everything - how progression works, how teams are structured, what leaders spend their time on. Most standard people frameworks assume a management hierarchy we don't have. Automate the repeatable: use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process. Think in process, scalability and iteration: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service. Measure whether they work and redesign when they don't fit the purpose. ✅ Requirements You do not need a CIPD qualification, and you do not need to have worked in a large, established HR function. You might have been a founder's associate or Chief of Staff at a Series A or B startup, holding the place together while it scaled. You might have built a People function from scratch and taken it from a one-person band to a well-oiled machine. You might have run a team or an Operations function where the people calls were effectively yours, even if People or HR never appeared in your job title. Or you might have done a different job that helped you build the skills below. A background in HR might help you do this job well, but it is not a requirement. Must-Haves You've held real accountability for decisions on people - you've partnered with leaders, or managed a team yourself, where hiring, performance and exit calls were either yours or made on your guidance. You can be trusted with the hardest conversations in the business and you're recognised for how you handle them, and you understand how decisions about people shape culture and employer brand - balancing efficiency with empathy. You've worked in or towards building a high-performance culture, and you're a confident challenger who carries conviction and can influence leadership decisions. You're comfortable operating without a playbook, in a company where the requirements and the shape of your role change constantly. You think from first principles, get to the root cause of complex problems, weigh competing considerations and anticipate second-order consequences. You're fluent with Notion, automation and AI tooling - your instinct is to build the thing rather than do it manually a second time - and you write clearly enough that a busy person reads it once and comes away with a clear idea of the situation and the next actions. Desirable Employment relations experience in the UK, Europe or the US - we operate across the UK and Europe today, with plans to expand to the US soon. Experience working across multiple countries, including employer of record arrangements. Compensation and benchmarking experience - salary banding, pay review cycles, market data. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with our Talent team. Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise we may ask you to prepare in advance. Hiring Manager interview. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Role Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you own the design of that thruster: you calculate it, design it, build it, test it in our own vacuum facilities and feed what you learn straight into the next iteration. You own the testing of your own designs, and your results decide what flies. Responsibilities Design Own the design of our RF gridded ion thruster and its performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration. Iterate rapidly to support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries. Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers on each new iteration of the ion propulsion system. Build and test Design and build the test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing. Assemble and operate test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities. Run electric propulsion tests on your own designs and analyse the results. Plan and run the test campaigns for your own designs. Verify Turn test results into design changes, then re-test. Document every test configuration and result so it gives traceable evidence for system verification and qualification. Requirements Essential Strong knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation. Hands-on electric propulsion testing, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances. Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition. Solid grounding in plasma physics, modelling, diagnostics and ionisation processes. Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site. Nice to have Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware. Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB). Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air. We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><em>At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://klaviyo.com/careers" data-renderer-mark="true">klaviyo.com/careers</a> to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.</em></p></div><p><strong>Klaviyo</strong>, a rapidly expanding NYSE listed enterprise technology company, is revolutionising the way businesses connect with their customers through advanced marketing automation solutions.  Our cutting-edge platform empowers companies to create personalized, data-driven campaigns that drive exceptional results. As a leader in the industry, Klaviyo is committed to innovation, customer success, and fostering a collaborative work environment.</p> <p>Named as one of the UK’s ‘Great Places To Work’ for the third year running, we are looking for individuals who want to join our dedicated team and help us grow our already impressive customer base in EMEA even further. </p> <p>We're seeking passionate <strong>Customer Success Professionals (CSMs)</strong> for our new state of the art and dynamic London office who thrive in a hybrid working environment (3 days in the office). Our mission is to exceed customer expectations and drive their growth. We're looking for CSMs who are dedicated to delivering the best experience to our EMEA customers.</p> <p><strong>This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a customer-first attitude, strong consultative and technical skills, and a proven track record of creatively solving unique problems in a fast-paced environment.</strong></p> <p><strong>Ideal candidates will have a strong background in CRM, Campaign Management, Data and Analytics, Digital, E-Commerce, or Marketing Technology Solutions.</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>How you will make a difference:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Transform workflows by putting AI at the centre, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.</li> <li>Be passionate about customer success and establish yourself as the trusted advisor for Klaviyo’s enterprise business.</li> <li>Drive positive Net Revenue Retention by mitigating churn risk and identifying opportunities for customer expansion and upgrades.</li> <li>Devise customized success plans based on customers' goals and challenges, holding customers accountable for driving action.</li> <li>Compose strategies to increase email, SMS, and digital channel revenue for all customers through the Klaviyo platform while driving growth and expansion.</li> <li>Proactively review customer performance, address any open issues, and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation.</li> <li>Keep customers up to date on product releases and new features.</li> <li>Share feedback with Product/Engineering to enhance customer engagement.</li> <li>Contribute to a positive team environment of collaboration, customer empathy, equality, and inclusion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of customer success or account management with a track record for building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders on an account at a time.</li> <li>An experienced marketer with a background in campaign management, CRM, digital marketing, data, or analytics.</li> <li>You’ve already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you’re excited to dive in and learn fast. You’re hungry to responsibly explore new AI tools and workflows, finding ways to make your work smarter and more efficient. </li> <li>Familiarity with Marketing Automation technologies.</li> <li>A proven track record of advising customers or executing marketing strategies.</li> <li>Customer success or account management experience with a history of building and nurturing relationships with multiple stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience explaining how to achieve key goals using software with end users.</li> <li>A track record of creative problem-solving for customers and end users.</li> <li>Comfortable discussing and supporting commercial conversations.</li> <li>Thrives in a collaborative environment.</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills via phone, video conference, and email.</li> <li>Curious and eager to learn.</li> <li>Adaptable to change and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Experience with G-Suite, Gainsight, Salesforce, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br><br></span></p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.</p> <p>In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility. </p> <p>Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE  range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range in Local Currency:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£72,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£108,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.</em></p> <p><strong>Get to Know Klaviyo</strong></p> <p>We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.</p> <p><em>AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). title: Senior Manager, Marketing Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are growing, and so is the breadth and depth of our marketing programs, with AI at the core of how we scale. We are looking for a highly motivated, diligent, and data-driven Senior Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Operations team. Reporting into the Director, Marketing Operations and Demand Generation, this role will serve as the analytical backbone of our growth marketing engine — leading the measurement, visualization, and insights infrastructure that drives smarter investment decisions and executive-level confidence in our marketing performance.</p> <p>In this role, you will own analytics and reporting across all growth marketing functions, from campaign performance to pipeline attribution. You'll partner closely with Growth Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other cross-functional teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and actionable across the full funnel. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Utilities Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 80 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027. Kraken is the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications. We’re now charging the Kraken platform to other utility industries (Water and Broadband) and have created a new team called - Kraken Utilities. Over the last 3 years we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry wide problems within the water and broadband sectors (such as customer experience & water leak detection). The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase, and has already signed six key clients: Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo. We are currently 120+ people strong globally. Our Technology Team has grown extremely quickly as a result, tripling in size within the last 18 months. With this rapid growth and the strong backing of our leadership, we are entering an exciting phase of becoming increasingly product-led and value-driven. We operate in a complex enterprise software market with large, high-profile clients. Therefore, we need PMs with a dual mindset: the strategic vision to proactively discover and solve deep industry problems, coupled with the rigorous execution skills required to steer massive, business-critical client migrations onto our platform. We will give you the space to do real product work, while trusting you to deliver on our most vital enterprise commitments. We operate with a high-trust, high-autonomy model. We are looking for a self-starter who thrives when given a complex problem and the freedom to solve it their way, working methodically to ensure projects go from inception to completion. You will act as the glue across multiple teams, putting the customer first and working empathetically to deliver the best possible solutions. About the team: We’re currently providing licences of our platform to serve the water and broadband industries and have created a new team - Kraken Utilities. Over the last year, we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry-wide problems within these sectors (such as transforming customer experience & water leak detection software). The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase. We are currently 100+ people (engineers, product, implementation, design, strategy) supported by the 1500+ people in the wider Kraken world. This role will join as a Product Manager focused specifically on the water industry—working in a tight-knit team and collaborating closely with our engineering, implementation, and strategy groups. What you'll do: Proactive Discovery: Act as a product-led PM. You won't just manage a backlog; you will proactively drive discovery, identify underlying customer problems, and figure out how to scale and grow your products to deliver massive value. Rigorous Delivery & Migrations: Balance your product vision with the realities of enterprise software. You will help steer significant migrations onto the Kraken platform, ensuring high-stakes, highly complex projects are delivered methodically and successfully for our clients. End-to-End Autonomy: You will be handed high-level business goals, not step-by-step instructions. You are expected to autonomously navigate ambiguity, prioritise your team's work, and drive solutions from initial inception to a successful rollout. Data-Driven Impact: Leverage data rigorously to spot new product opportunities and actively measure the impact of what your team delivers. You ensure we are building for measurable outcomes, not just shipping features. Embrace New Technologies: You naturally integrate modern tools (including AI) to accelerate your work and explore how new technologies can enhance our product. Support the Frontline: Partner with customer teams working on front-line support to quickly triage operational issues, using these insights to continuously improve the platform. What you'll have: The Enterprise/Product Balance: A proven track record in B2B product management (ideally enterprise software). You understand the delicate balance between pushing a visionary product roadmap and delivering on critical, heavy-lift client commitments. (While we anticipate this usually takes 3 to 5 years of experience, we care far more about your actual impact, high agency, and capability than a strict number of years on your CV). Structured Thinking: Attention to detail and thinking in systems, both are vital for managing complex, high-volume, business-critical products and large-scale migrations in a dynamic environment. Strategic Prioritisation: A history of confidently managing competing demands. You recognise what needs to be done immediately to achieve our goals and have the autonomy to say "no" to distractions. Tenacity and a "Just Do It" Attitude: You don't give up at the first hurdle. You are willing to dive deep, get your hands dirty, and push through blockers and failures to deliver real impact. For example, if a complex issue arises, you familiarise with the relevant domain, find a way to collect associated data, troubleshoot, and liaise with relevant parties throughout. Excellent Communication: Strong written and verbal skills with the ability to interact seamlessly with people of varying technical backgrounds. You are a great listener who can spot and harness fantastic ideas from anywhere inside and outside of the business. You understand that leveraging AI and scaling complex systems for large enterprises increases the need for exceptional, structured documentation to guide engineering and ensure system integrity. Industry experience: Previous experience in the water industry or other utilities is a bonus, but not a requirement. title: TechOps Lead
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What is TechOps? TechOps at Kraken is a modern, lean evolution of traditional enterprise IT. We span everything from hands-on frontline support through to high-impact technical projects and long-term strategic improvements. We are building a small, highly effective TechOps team and are looking for an ambitious, experienced TechOps Generalist to help us scale Kraken safely, securely, and with a strong focus on people. This is a broad role with a huge amount of variety. You’ll work across identity, devices, SaaS, networking, automation, and office infrastructure - often at the same time. Ambiguity is a constant, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys making sense of it and turning it into action. We operate almost entirely in the cloud, so you’ll be exposed to a wide range of modern tools and technologies across the business. 🏡 Where you'll fit in As a TechOps Team Lead, you will be responsible for the end-to-end running of the Kraken TechOps function. This is a leadership role that requires someone comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, while remaining closely aligned with global TechOps leadership. We strongly believe that no matter what role you have within TechOps, it’s still important to keep your ear to the ground and see first-hand the problems our people are facing, and the impact that decisions you make have on everyone at Kraken. This means you’ll spend a significant portion of your time helping out with day-to-day support alongside your leadership responsibilities. As a Team Lead within TechOps, you will be responsible for balancing the team’s everyday workload, managing capacity, and prioritising proactive, planned project work alongside reactive support and unplanned work. The TechOps team operates in an environment with a large amount of ambiguity, and we are looking for someone who can make sense of this, identify the most impactful work, and keep the team focused, motivated and moving at pace. This is a strategically significant role which will require close collaboration with our UK and APAC leaders. You will bring strong leadership skills, service management, and operational experience, with the ability to lead, scale, and mature this function in line with Kraken’s growth trajectory. You will have experience in: Significant people leadership experience Scaling teams and services over time Service management, capacity planning, and operational maturity Managing support pipelines, projects, and assignments Building regional processes while balancing global standards Working with internal and external stakeholders and vendors Driving reliability, consistency, and continuous improvement You will bring strong technical depth across areas such as identity, MDM, networking, office infrastructure, and SaaS, with the confidence to challenge partners and vendors when needed. You will be comfortable owning incident management, security and compliance considerations, and contract and service quality oversight. This is a huge opportunity for the right candidate to step in and lead an amazing team that is critical to keeping Kraken moving at pace. 🚀 What you’ll own Define what good looks like for a small, lean, high-performing TechOps team. Own the day-to-day delivery of TechOps services. Support global operations with opportunities to travel to our global sites. Liaise with TechOps leadership and architects to prioritise and deliver project work. Balance reactive support and projects with proactive, planned improvements and projects. Mentor and line manage TechOps team members, supporting their development and career growth. Provide hands-on 1st, 2nd and 3rd line technical support across the business. Collaborate closely with our Security team to balance security, productivity, and user experience. Manage incidents, communications, and follow-ups. . Coordinate and deliver complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders and teams across time zones. Examples of TechOps projects include: Rollout of, and migration to, a new identity provider macOS and Windows MDM migrations Rollout of device trust and posture compliance solutions Replacing insecure factors such as SMS with phishing-resistant authentication Office fit-outs including networking, AV, and access control SaaS migrations for acquisitions (e.g. Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace) 🧠 What you bring to the party Must have A proven track record of leading successful IT or TechOps teams, ideally through periods of growth. At least 3 years of people management experience. Significant experience managing performance, and professional development. Strong service management and operational experience. Comfort operating in highly ambiguous environments and managing competing priorities. A very strong technical background underpinning your leadership approach. Hands-on experience providing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd line support. Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong incident management and problem-solving skills. A people-first mindset and a conscientious approach to decision-making. Should have Experience working across time zones and with globally distributed teams Strong opinions on best practice and a desire to challenge traditional IT norms. Experience mentoring team members with varying levels of experience. Experience supporting macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android environments. Experience with Identity & Access Management platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra. Willingness to travel and maintain presence in regional office locations if required. ⭐️ Bonus points A foundational understanding of programming or software engineering. Familiarity with security tooling such as CrowdStrike, Kolide, osquery, and Zscaler. Experience with email gateway administration and routing. Don't think you check off all of the above? Role Description Allica works with 300+ third parties that deliver services our customers and colleagues depend on. Managing the risk, resilience and value of those arrangements is a business need, and as a regulated bank they are also subject to demanding and evolving supervisory expectations. This role designs, owns and drives adoption of the end-to-end third-party management framework (sourcing, contracting, onboarding, ongoing assurance and exit), holds the business accountable for operating it consistently, and is accountable both for third-party risk being understood, controlled and held within appetite, and for the Bank meeting its regulatory obligations for its third-party arrangements. The mandate is Bank-wide: this role sets the standard, owns the tooling and holds the data, and is accountable for the framework delivering control in practice. Accountability for each individual supplier relationship sits with the relevant business or service owner. It measures adherence and works alongside owners to resolve what is outstanding, escalating where that support has not moved the position. Its authority comes from the framework it owns, the governance it runs and the evidence it brings, backed by clarity, credibility and persistence. Principal Accountabilities Strategy and framework • A coherent Bank-wide operating model. Set the procurement and third-party management strategy, governance and roadmap so that commercial decision-making and risk management operate as one joined-up discipline. • Proportionate control throughout the lifecycle. Own policies, standards and control requirements that apply greater scrutiny where risk and materiality are higher, while keeping the process practical for lower-risk arrangements. • Clear and exercised accountability. Define decision rights across supplier owners and the relevant first-line functions, secure approval through the appropriate governance bodies, and ensure responsibilities are understood, exercised and evidenced in practice, intervening directly where they are not. • A function that keeps pace with the Bank. Translate business growth, regulatory change, new technology and lessons from incidents or assurance into a prioritised improvement roadmap supported by evidence of control effectiveness. Procurement and commercial management • Commercial value that is visible and evidenced. Create a consistent approach to demand, sourcing, benchmarking, negotiation, renewal and savings validation so the Bank can demonstrate the value achieved from third-party spend. • Stronger outcomes from material negotiations. Lead or support significant contracts and renewals, bringing market insight, leverage and disciplined trade-offs while protecting service quality, resilience, customer outcomes and the control environment. • Contracts that work as control instruments. Working with Legal, ensure contractual positions reflect the nature and materiality of the arrangement, including service levels, information and audit rights, data and security, subcontracting, business continuity, termination and exit requirements. Set those requirements before negotiation opens, and escalate through governance where the terms achievable fall short of risk appetite. • Fewer avoidable last-minute decisions. Maintain a forward view of procurement activity, expiries and renewals so the Bank has time to test the market, remediate control gaps or execute an alternative strategy. Third-party risk and governance • Ensure the third-party register is accurate, current and supported by consistent materiality and risk assessments, with regulatory notifications made when required. • Intragroup arrangements held to the same standard. Own the framework's application to intragroup and affiliate arrangements, ensuring they are recorded, assessed for materiality and risk, supported by documented agreements and service expectations, and covered by proportionate exit and resilience planning. Group ownership does not reduce the Bank's accountability for the service or the risk. • Ongoing assurance that reflects actual risk. Set and oversee the cadence for due diligence refresh, service and risk review, control attestation and remediation, with frequency and depth driven by tier, materiality and emerging concerns. • Credible exit capability. Require exit plans, prioritised by tier and importance to the Bank's important business services, and work with supplier owners and Operational Resilience to ensure the most important plans are tested and actionable. • Portfolio-level visibility of concentration and dependency risk. Maintain a current view of exposure across providers, services, technologies, locations, fourth parties and subcontracting chains, and escalate concentrations that exceed or threaten risk appetite. • Continuous supervisory readiness, owned end to end. Ensure the Bank can respond quickly and credibly to PRA, FCA, Internal Audit and Board requests with traceable data, clear ownership, evidence of challenge and an accurate account of outstanding risk. Business owner enablement, oversight and assurance • Enablement that is hands-on. Provide practical training, guidance and advice that make the expected standard clear at each stage of the third-party lifecycle, and work directly with owners on complex, material or high-risk arrangements. • Adherence that is measured and visible. Define measures of completion, timeliness and quality; make performance transparent by owner and business area; and distinguish isolated delay from systemic control weakness. • Exceptions that lead to action. Follow through on overdue assessments, attestations and remediation, helping owners remove blockers and escalating constructively when risk, evidence or progress remains insufficient. Ownership runs until the gap is closed, not until it has been raised. • A rising baseline of capability across the Bank. Use recurring issues, quality reviews and feedback from supplier owners to simplify the process and target capability-building where it will have the greatest impact. Data, tooling and automation • One trusted source of third-party information. Establish clear data ownership, definitions and quality controls so executive, Board and regulatory reporting can be produced from governed data rather than reconciled spreadsheets. • A platform that supports the operating model and reduces manual effort. Give executives and the Board a concise view of material arrangements, risk exposure, control adherence, concentration, incidents, remediation, renewals, spend, savings and forward priorities. title: Public Sector Lead, Defence & Security
description: <h2>About Scale</h2> <p>Scale builds AI systems for decisions that matter. We started out providing the data and evaluation behind many of the world's leading models, and we still work with the major frontier labs on research and post-training. Today we also build full applications: we take an organisation's own data and expertise, forward deploy alongside their teams, and build the systems they come to rely on, powered by the Scale GenAI Platform.</p> <h2>The Role</h2> <p>Defence is under pressure to adopt AI at pace. The 2025 Strategic Defence Review and the Defence AI Strategy push for AI to move from experiment to operational capability, Defence Digital and UK Strategic Command are driving digital and data programmes across the department, and the enabling organisations are being asked to field reliable systems, not pilots. Scale wants to play a foundational role in building the dependable AI applications that shift depends on.</p> <p>We're looking for someone to lead that work across UK defence and the national security community. You'd own our commercial relationships across the Ministry of Defence and its enabling organisations - Defence Digital, UK Strategic Command, DE&S, and Dstl - and the broader defence and security customer base.</p> <p>This is a critical role reporting directly to the new Public Sector leader. You'd carry a number, win deals yourself, and build a small team behind you as the work grows. It suits someone who has sold into defence before and knows how it actually makes decisions, not just how the org charts look.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Own our commercial plan and pipeline for UK defence and security</li> <li>Find, shape, and close deals yourself, from the first conversation through to contract and into delivery</li> <li>Use the relationships you already have across the MOD, Defence Digital, UK Strategic Command, DE&S, Dstl, and the security and intelligence community</li> <li>Work the defence routes to market, and know which are worth the effort and which aren't (the Defence Sourcing Portal, DASA, JOSCAR registration, single-source arrangements, and the main CCS frameworks)</li> <li>Be a credible counterpart to senior military and civil service leaders, and turn what they need into work we can actually deliver</li> <li>Navigate the security clearance, accreditation, and information-handling requirements that come with defence work</li> <li>Stay close to our product and delivery teams so what we sell is what we build</li> <li>Hire and lead a small team over time, and help shape the wider UK public sector plan as a team with the Central Government Lead and Public Sector leader.</li> </ul> <h2>What we're looking for</h2> <ul> <li>You've sold and delivered technology or transformation work into UK defence or national security, either from a vendor or SI or from inside the MOD or the Armed Forces</li> <li>You know at least one part of defence well (MOD, UK Strategic Command, DE&S, Dstl, or a single Service) and how it buys</li> <li>You understand defence and public sector procurement: frameworks, tenders, single-source rules, and buying that runs through a lot of stakeholders</li> <li>You've opened doors, run complex pursuits, and owned the result</li> <li>You have relationships with senior people in defence</li> <li>You hold, or are eligible to obtain, UK security clearance (SC as a minimum; DV desirable)</li> <li>You do your best work when things are ambiguous and moving quickly</li> </ul> <p>People who tend to fit this have spent years leading UK defence work at companies like Palantir, Anduril, BAE Systems, QinetiQ, Leidos or Babcock, at consultancies and systems integrators like Accenture, Deloitte, EY or PA Consulting, or in senior commercial or programme roles inside the MOD, DE&S, or the Armed Forces.</p> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with AI or data-heavy platforms</li> <li>Regulated, mission-critical, or classified government programmes</li> <li>You've built or run a small commercial team before</li> </ul> <h2>Why join</h2> <p>You'd be building this market, not maintaining it. There's no playbook to inherit, which is rather the point. The deals you win, and the way you win them, will shape how Scale works with UK defence for years.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at ----- Please see the United States Department of Labor's </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights poster</em></a><em> for additional information.</em></p> <p><em>We comply with the United States Department of Labor's </em><em>Pay Transparency provision</em><em>. </em></p> <p><em><strong>PLEASE NOTE: </strong>We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our <a href="https://scale.com/legal/privacy" target="_blank">privacy policy</a> for additional information.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London OR UK Remote | 💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission) +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨<strong>Fixed-Term 12-month contract 📝</strong></p> <p><strong>*Please note we cannot sponsor visas for this role</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Business Banking team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Monzo Business is on a mission to make banking effortless for small businesses. We help people start, run and grow their businesses with simple, transparent banking and tools that reduce financial admin, so they can spend more time focusing on what matters most.</p> <p>We're launching Monzo Business in Spain, initially focusing on sole traders and simple micro-businesses. While many customers will use a self-serve journey, we know there are moments where speaking to a real person can make all the difference.</p> <p>As our founding Spanish Sales Account Executive, you'll be based in London as part of our UK Sales team, and working closely with Spain Go-To-Market, Product and Marketing teams. You'll combine hands-on sales with gathering customer insight — helping potential customers move forward while shaping the playbook for how Sales can best support our growth in Spain.</p> <p>This is more than just a traditional Sales AE role focused solely on sales conversion. You will also have the opportunity to test, learn and influence how we build a safe, effective and scalable sales motion for Spain from the ground up.</p> <p><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with prospective Spanish SMB customers through discovery calls, emails and messaging, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Be a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services. Explaining Monzo Business's proposition, product capabilities and application process clearly, helping customers understand their next step without providing financial, tax, legal or regulatory advice.</li> <li>Drive full sales cycle, from early prospecting and qualification; to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation. Drive activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up and onboarded.</li> <li>Understand and capture detailed customer objections and feedback. Turn customer conversations into structured and actionable learnings and insights by identifying recurring questions, unmet needs, and journey friction and more.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Go To Market, Product and Marketing teams by collecting, analysing and sharing sales feedback to help teams make rapid and data-driven adjustments</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking. Qualifying and prioritising opportunities, handling objections and following up consistently to help customers progress through their journey.</li> <li>Helping shape our Spain sales playbook, including messaging, qualification, objection handling, scripts and customer journeys. Help create and refine Spanish-language scripts, FAQs, objection handling and sales processes.</li> <li>Deliver outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email, text or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieve sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands-on sales experience, ideally as an Account Executive, Sales Development Representative or Business Development Representative, and are comfortable qualifying opportunities, handling objections and following up with customers.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with Spanish culture, customer expectations and communication styles, and the judgement to adapt your approach accordingly.</li> <li>Fluent Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication in both languages.</li> <li>Strong consultative communication skills: you listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and explain complex topics simply.</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers who may be unfamiliar with Monzo or uncertain about changing their banking setup.</li> <li>You have experience gathering, structuring and analysing commercial or customer data. You enjoy working cross-functionally and can turn what you're hearing from customers into useful insights for teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, Risk and Compliance.</li> <li>You have experience selling to or supporting small businesses, ideally within financial services, SaaS or another complex service environment.</li> <li>You're excited by experimentation and comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-changing environment where you'll help shape processes and playbooks as well as follow them.</li> <li>You're highly organised, comfortable working with CRM tools or structured customer data, and bring strong judgement, integrity and customer care to every interaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have experience with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Selling to or supporting Spanish sole traders, micro-businesses or SMEs.</li> <li>Banking, payments or another regulated industry.</li> <li>Selling a new and unfamiliar product to market</li> <li>Customer research, voice-of-customer programmes, sales enablement or GTM experimentation.</li> <li>Background in consultative services. </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍This role can based in our London office or remotely in the UK</p> <p>ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>20 min recruiter call</li> <li>30 min call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Take home task and in person task review</li> <li>45 min behavioural interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-OS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards
